text:
margaret: Heads-up 1: Reporter from FastCompany DM'd about our benchmark post. They want a short methods blurb and an exec-style sentence for a pull-quote. Can someone own?
press_ops: I can coordinate. Do we have a one-line methods summary we can share quickly?
amy_legal: If it's strictly factual (hardware, cache on/off), legal OK fast. Avoid comparative language.
josh_eng: Methods we can share: 'Benchmarks run on Dedicated (NVIDIA A100 series), P99 latency measured across 1k tokenized requests; baseline runs disabled KV-prefix cache and used q4f16 quantization.'
margaret: Nice. For the quote, keep it high level. Suggest: "We run benchmarks to surface real-world tradeoffs between latency and cost so teams can make better serving choices."
sophie_social: For social: "New benchmark live  production serving tradeoffs: latency vs cost. Read more: short.redwood/bench"
amy_legal: Approved as-is (no percent claims).
press-monitor-bot: Noted: FastCompany ping recorded.
press_ops: Sending both to reporter and asked for a 30m window. Asked if they'd like an embargo 1 they said no.
press-monitor-bot: External mention detected: FastCompany draft linked 1 https://fastco.example/redwood-bench-draft
press_ops: Reporter will include exact quote. Adding thread to media tracker.
sophie_social: Scheduling social push at T+10. Can ops confirm hero image?
margaret: Use the benchmark hero shot from the blog. Ops, please confirm assets uploaded to CDN.
press_ops: Confirmed. Reporter published: https://fastco.example/redwood-bench (tracked).
sophie_social: Amplifying now.
margaret: Post-mortem action: create a short "same-day quote" checklist (legal, press_ops, social) and a canned methods blurb library. I'll draft tomorrow. :memo:
